title: Your page, the way you drew it
notes: Your page is your own design now, and it fills the whole phone: months and years across the top, your banner, your card, the journal, a bookshelf of albums, the boombox, the calendar, Live Feed, Love and Friends.
Tap ArcMe at the top for the menu; tap a month, a year or a date to go to that day.
Tap the boombox to play; My Music to choose a song or sign in to Apple Music.
Prefer another look? Menu → Page look → Theme.
